definitions.scope: Counts measure supplied snapshot records, not the total market or completeness against all official calendars.
definitions.past: event.date < as_of; today_future is event.date >= as_of. Event-local dates only, not intraday release timestamps; a past date is not evidence a release occurred.
definitions.non_estimated_status: Only confirmed/released labels are counted; these labels, source URLs and last_verified_at do not independently prove date verification or publication of results.
definitions.values: Field presence after snapshot placeholder normalisation; numeric/string zero is present. Actual, consensus and prior are separate. Presence is not factual validation.
definitions.numerical_evidence: Read-only consistency checks of recorded structured evidence against the current local numerical mapping contract; no publisher is fetched and no independent factual certification is implied. Source IDs, URLs, status labels and observation_fields alone never verify a scalar. The seven field classifications partition records; valid_evidence_without_scalar is an additional missing-field diagnostic. Invalid-entry reasons use the first failed guard.
definitions.exact_observations: Implemented ONS monthly mappings and DOL seasonally adjusted weekly initial claims only. Checks require matching occurrence, country, elapsed release timing/stage, explicit reference period, units, registered metric/source identifiers, numerical meaning, role, numeric value and ordered capture/check timestamps. DOL requires an edition-verified occurrence/week binding and document fingerprint; its historical table alone never establishes old publication clocks. Unsupported consensus observations are invalid. Current means data_stale=false with a consistent recorded row status, not a live freshness guarantee; snapshot age is independent. Known/check timestamps must be no later than the earlier of generated_at (including its represented second when fractional seconds are omitted) and the end of as_of in UTC. Current and stale row counts can overlap when roles differ. observation_fields declarations do not substitute for scalar/evidence comparison.
definitions.structured_auction_summaries: Treasury actual summaries are checked against their numeric auction object, security family and CUSIP/issue-date native identity. They are counted separately from exact observations: snapshots do not preserve a per-result feed/check/vintage timestamp, so freshness is unknown unless explicitly stale. Exact text/label/unit suffix agreement is required; matching an auction object does not establish when results were published or independently reverify them. No prior or consensus is inferred.
definitions.actual_coverage: Denominator is past dated nonholiday records only. It includes estimated dates and events where a numerical actual may not apply; excludes today/future and undated records. Empty denominator has null percent.
definitions.horizon: Known scheduled dates only. Empty months and dates after the last known row are availability flags, not proof an official release is missing; sources may not have published schedules. Partial boundary months are included. No recurrence expectation is inferred.
definitions.freshness: Calendar-day age of snapshot generated_at in UTC relative to as_of, independent of how far scheduled dates extend. Build timestamps do not prove source verification.
definitions.registry: Snapshot series declarations define zero-record series. Local engine registry membership is an optional, separately labelled comparison.
definitions.country: Country/area codes; EU denotes the euro area. Economic-indicator economies require observed economic-indicators rows, not holidays or central-bank-only rows. Missing row country/category falls back to its declared series metadata.
